_purpose: A correct write must not be reported as a failed one. set_property confirms a write by re-applying the request to what is actually there, so an enum sent as a number, or fully qualified, or an object path inside an array, all count as landed even though the property reads back in its own canonical spelling. The other half is that the check still has teeth: a number no enumerator answers to is refused outright, and a write that really is reverted still fails. Also covers get_subsystem, where the node class has to be chosen from the subsystem's family.
_reading: The expect_failure steps pass BY being refused. The two that matter most are the out-of-range enum - which the engine's importer would otherwise write with no bounds check and no log - and the non-instance-editable variable, which is the case the whole write-confirmation exists for.
_requires: Any project. Creates its own actor and Blueprint under /Game/UplinkScenarios and deletes them again. Editor world.
